edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient address.
msg.sender feeds the pseudo-random seed in randomIndex.
block.timestamp is used as entropy for the token randomness, making the outcome timestamp dependent and miner-influenceable.
nonce is read as part of the randomness seed.
randomIndex increments nonce after computing the index.
tokenIdx shuffle array is read to resolve already-swapped indices.
randomIndex writes the swap mapping into tokenIdx.
MAX_TOKENS is subtracted from totalSupply to bound the modulo, a value that must never underflow.
numTokens parameter controls how many tokens mint loops over.
numTokens is used in add/sub/mul bounds and payment computations inside mint.
MAX_TOKENS participates in MAX_TOKENS.sub(...) inside mint.
MAX_GIVEAWAY_TOKENS participates in MAX_GIVEAWAY_TOKENS.sub(countMintedGiveawayTokens) inside mint.
countMintedGiveawayTokens is subtracted when bounding the sale supply.
TOKEN_PRICE.mul(numTokens) computes the required payment.
mint executes the add/sub/mul supply and price bound checks.
mint increments countMintedTokens for each minted token.
numTokens parameter drives the giveaway mint loop.
mintGiveaway increments countMintedGiveawayTokens.
onlyOwner on mintGiveaway validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner on setMembersAddresses validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner on withdrawAll validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner on startMint validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner on pauseMint validates msg.sender against the stored owner.
mint calls mintWithRandomTokenId once per requested token.
mintGiveaway calls mintWithRandomTokenId once per giveaway token.
mintWithRandomTokenId invokes randomIndex to obtain a token id.
_to recipient is forwarded into the safe mint call.
randomIndex composes an unsafe pseudo-random value from chain-visible and miner-influenceable data.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on a contract recipient, allowing reentrant execution.
withdrawAll calls the private _widthdraw helper five times.
withdrawAll pays out via raw value calls before the function completes, exposing reentrancy.
_widthdraw performs a raw call{value} to an arbitrary address, handing control to untrusted code.
_address parameter is the target of the raw payout call.
_amount parameter is the value forwarded in the raw payout call.
_amount is sent in the low-level value call that transfers control externally.
w1 receives 8% of the withdrawn balance.
w2 receives 8% of the withdrawn balance.
w3 receives 28% of the withdrawn balance.
w4 receives 28% of the withdrawn balance.
w5 receives the remaining contract balance.
withdrawAll caches address(this).balance into the balance local.
_a array elements are read and assigned to payout state variables.
setMembersAddresses writes _a[0] into w1 without bounds validation.
setMembersAddresses writes _a[1] into w2 without bounds validation.
setMembersAddresses writes _a[2] into w3 without bounds validation.
setMembersAddresses writes _a[3] into w4 without bounds validation.
setMembersAddresses writes _a[4] into w5 without bounds validation.
baseURI parameter is stored through setBaseURI.
setBaseURI writes the new value into _baseTokenURI.
tokenURI reads _baseTokenURI through _baseURI to build metadata URIs.
_owner parameter determines which address tokens are enumerated for.
tokenCount controls the loop bound and array allocation in tokensOfOwner.
tokenId parameter is used to resolve the token metadata URI.
interfaceId parameter is compared against supported interface ids.
startMint sets isStarted to true.
pauseMint sets isStarted to false.

normalization_plan.reason: numTokens is an input-only parameter of mint and should be folded into the mint core function node.
numTokens is an input-only parameter of mintGiveaway and belongs to the mintGiveaway core node.
baseURI is a transient argument of setBaseURI and should be merged into it.
_to only transits through mintWithRandomTokenId into the safe mint call.
_address is a transient argument of the private _widthdraw helper.
_amount directly parameterizes the raw value call unsafe operation.
_a is a transient argument of setMembersAddresses used to populate payout addresses.
_owner is a transient argument of the tokensOfOwner view function.
tokenId is a transient argument of tokenURI.
interfaceId is a transient argument of supportsInterface.
availableTokens is a local bound computed and consumed only inside randomIndex.
rnd is a local random index consumed only inside randomIndex.
value is a local resolved token index used only inside randomIndex.
balance is a local caching address(this).balance inside withdrawAll.
tokenCount is a local loop bound inside tokensOfOwner.
_tokenID is a local produced by randomIndex and consumed by mintWithRandomTokenId.
